title: What is OpenAI Codex?

body.text: AI agent for writing and editing code automatically
— it works in a separate sandbox, runs real code, tests it, and hands you the result to review before merging.

example: "Add unit tests for the calculateDiscount() function in cart.js, covering all edge cases"
